name: artifacts-os

scripts.test: node scripts/bundle-assets.mjs && node --test "test/*.test.ts" && cd templates/tpl-scheduled-scan && node tests/run.js

description: Artifacts-OS: an edge runtime for personal agents on Cloudflare Workers + Artifacts

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account id (for AI Gateway routing).

AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: AI Gateway token; provider keys are stored at the gateway.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional: only used by Codex in the container when AI Gateway is not configured.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Optional: the one identity allowed to use this personal runtime.
